name: @pemo/resident-portal
description: PEMO resident portal shell. Navigation, design-system translation and discriminated state scaffolding. Renders no facility, booking, price or availability data — that is a later PID, gated on API-027-ST.

scripts.generate: node --experimental-strip-types tool/generate-tokens.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tool/generate-icons.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tool/generate-corpus.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tool/generate-style-4s.ts
scripts.test: pnpm run test:node && pnpm run test:browser

//stack: Ruled for UI-019-ST and inherited here per R2: React 19 + Vite 6 + TypeScript, no component library, node:test for logic and Playwright for the browser. The runtime shipped to a browser is react, react-dom, scheduler and qrcode-generator — four packages, and the complete list. qrcode-generator (zero dependencies, no network) draws visitor-pass QR codes client-side; adding it was a decision. This PID renders no data, so it carries no network client and no fixture corpus.
//no-component-library: R2 puts the portal on the UI-019/022/024 discipline. A navigation shell of semantic HTML is what the platform does best; every MUI component 09 names is either a shell primitive built here or a costed gap named in COMPONENT-TRANSLATION.md. Adopting MUI would ship +80 runtime packages for a shell that needs none.
//no-vitest-no-jsdom: jsdom has no layout engine, so a suite asserting Traditional Chinese renders in a real sidebar cannot fail for the right reason. Playwright runs a real Chromium; the higher-fidelity option is also the cheaper one. UI-011-ST F6.
//no-plugin-react: @vitejs/plugin-react costs 48 packages, almost all Babel, and buys Fast Refresh a fixture-free shell does not need. Vite's esbuild handles JSX via esbuild.jsx in vite.config.ts.
//no-analytics: No runtime analytics, crash reporting or attribution SDK. This is a STANDING PROJECT RULE for the resident application (PID-INDEX, written for UI-007-ST); the portal is a resident application, so the rule governs it by nature. test/deps/no-analytics-sdk.test.ts fails the build if the runtime dependency set ever grows beyond the allowlist.
//font-dependency: Requires a Traditional Chinese font on the host — fonts-noto-cjk on Debian/Ubuntu. Without one, Chinese renders as tofu, and tofu has a reasonable advance width, so a width-based assertion passes while measuring nothing. UI-019-ST F3.
//generated-sources: src/**/*.g.ts and src/**/*.g.css are generated by tool/ and committed. Regenerate-and-compare tests fail on a stale generated file. Never hand-edit them.
